entry.title: Dominic Fletcher: According to a source, the #reds signed OF Dominic Fletcher to a Minor League contract with an invite to big league Spring Training. Fletcher, formerly of the White Sox and Diamondbacks, finished 2026 with Triple-A Louisville when he signed in September after being released by the Pirates org.

Emilio Pagán: "We have to be open-minded. We have to look to add innings in a number of different ways. Everything is on the table for us right now.” --Scott Harris after officially announcing the signing of reliever Emilio Pagan

Cincinnati Reds offseason notes: The deadline to protect players ahead of the Rule 5 Draft is today at 6 pm ET. Among those eligible for the draft if not protected are #reds top 30 prospects Cam Collier, Jay Allen II, Carter Graham and Carlos Sanchez.

Duncan Davitt: The #reds have claimed off waivers RHP Duncan Davitt from the Giants and RHP Paxton Shultz from the Nationals.
